note: South Sudan, read on 2026-10-30 in the Passports and Immigration Act, 2011 (enacted by the Southern Sudan Legislative Assembly; in force on the President's signature), as the UNHCR's ecoi.net holds it, chapter V, residence. Aliens with valid residence permits may reside in South Sudan (s. 18). A Special Residence Permit may be granted to aliens continuously resident for at least three years, or lawfully staying more than five years and carrying out scientific, technical or commercial activities the Minister deems of value, and is valid and renewable for five-year periods (s. 19: term five years, renewable). An Ordinary Residence Permit may be granted to aliens continuously resident for at least five years, or lawfully resident more than two years and carrying out such activities, valid and renewable for two-year periods (s. 20(1)-(2): two years). Aliens eligible for neither may be granted a Temporary Residence Permit, valid and renewable for periods not exceeding twelve months (s. 20(3)-(4): renewable, no term written, twelve months being a most). A special or ordinary permit is forfeited after more than six months' continuous absence without a return visa (s. 21). A permit extends to the alien's spouse or spouses, children and dependants (s. 23). None of the three is tied to a purpose, so each is `general`; the long-residence permits' years aren't permanent residence in the form's sense, so none is written as `permanent`. The Act sets no fees, decision time or work rights in this chapter; the Ministry of Labour's work permit (Labour Act 2017, the work engine's) is separate. Whether later amendments or regulations changed these permits wasn't found.

sources.title: The Laws of Southern Sudan, Passports and Immigration Act, 2011 (ecoi.net)
sources.said: PASSPORTS AND IMMIGRATION ACT, 2011 ... Except as provided in this Chapter, aliens with valid residence permits shall be permitted to reside in South Sudan. ... Aliens who have been continuously residing in South Sudan for a period of not less than three (3) years; or ... A Special residence permit shall be valid and renewable for another five year periods. ... Aliens who have been continuously residing in South Sudan for not less than five years; or ... An Ordinary Residence Permit shall be valid and renewable for two year periods. ... Aliens not eligible for special or ordinary residence permits may be granted temporary residence permits. ... A temporary residence permit shall be valid and renewable for periods not exceeding twelve months. ... A residence permit shall extend to the alien, his or her spouse or spouses, children and dependents.
